title: WPMS/2022/2021 of VIJAY PRASAD BHATT Vs DISTRICT MAGISTRATE DEHRADUN

paras.text:
SL.
No Date
Office Notes, reports,
orders or proceedings
or directions and
Registrar's order with
Signatures
COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
28.09.2021 WPMS No. 2022 of 2021
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal, Advocate, for
the petitioner.
Mr. T.S. Phartiyal, Addl. CSC, for the
State.
The learned counsel for the petitioner
contends, that though without there being any
order on record, that the petitioner claims that
he was allotted a residential accommodation by
the Jail Authorities, on the pretext that since he
was functioning as a priest of a temple, he
continued to occupy the same ever since 2009,
till culmination of the proceedings under the
Public Premises Act, which was decided on
11.09.2017, by way of Eviction Case No. 1 of
2015-16, under Sections 4 & 5 of the Act,
which, later on, stood affirmed by the Appellate
Court's order dated 19.08.2021, rendered in
Public Premises Appeal No. 66 of 2017.
It is by the concurrent unchallenged
orders, the petitioner has been held to be an
unauthorized occupant of the public premises.
The petitioner has filed a writ petition with a
prayer of mandamus, directing the respondents
to release the households, which he contends, as
it to have been taken in the custody by the
respondents, when they had forcefully evicted
the petitioner in his absence on 13.08.2021.
The manner in which the relief has
been modulated, no writ of mandamus, as such,
could be issued, because the action taken would
fall to be as a consequence of adjudication and
the petitioner having been determined as to be
an unauthorised occupant.
The matter was taken up yesterday.
The learned counsel for the petitioner requested
that the matter to be posted today, as fresh and

during the course of the proceedings, he has
handed over a communication dated
07.08.2021, which has been issued by the office
of the Jail Superintendent, wherein it has been
directed, that the petitioner has been called upon
by the Jail Superintendent, to approach before
him in order to enable him to handover the
household articles, which had been taken over
by the jail authority, while taking over the
possession of the property in pursuance to the
orders passed under Uttar Pradesh Public
Premises (Eviction of Unauthorised Occupants)
Act, 1972.
Without venturing into the merits of
the writ petition, while holding it to be not
maintainable, before this Court, it is left open
for the petitioner to approach before the
Superintendent of Jail, District Jail, Dehradun,
in compliance of the Communication No.
4020/21 dated 07.08.2021, for the redressal of
his grievance.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 28.09.2021 Mahinder/
